blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—The Abra Solid North Weavers beefed up their frontline with the signing of former Rain or Shine Elasto Painters import Jaylen Johnson. He’ll see action in their East Asia Super League (EASL) debut on October 3 at the SM Seaside Arena Cebu. The 6’9″ Johnson will join the Weavers as their naturalized player. He’ll add more muscle and experience to Abra’s roster for its first EASL campaign. Johnson is the second foreign reinforcement brought in by Abra after former UAAP Most Valuable Player Malick Diouf.
